ValidationRule.description: Fields: Booked MRR (rollup), Term, Est. Start Date - required at Stage of Propose or later for Managed Services record type Case00016020 - removed requirement for Booked MRR to allow negative and zero dollar opps.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Opportunity', OR ( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Propose"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Contract"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Approve"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") ), OR( ISBLANK( Duration_in_Months__c ), ISBLANK( Est_Start_Date__c ) ) , ISBLANK( Project__c ) ) && NOT($Permission.BypassValidationRules) && NOT( $User.Id = '0053b00000CSZR6')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The following fields are required to move this Opportunity to the next stage: Estimated Start Date, Term, Booked MRR (rollup).
